# Local Test

<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

On the **Local Test** page you can add and preview your app on your local system and share it with internal testers.

> **Local Test is for Development**
>
> The **Local Test** page is available only in the **Development** view.

## Requirements for local testing

The wizard verifies if you have completed all requirements and displays a list of any fields you need to complete.

![](/img/local-test2.png)

## Preview app

Click **Preview Your App Listing Page** to see a summary of your app's details and a preview your app's listing page.

## Add App

Click **Add app now** to authorize and add the app to your local Zoom client.
User-managed apps are then displayed in the client in **My apps**.

Unlike user-managed apps, admin-managed apps are managed through the web portal and are hidden from the Zoom client.

## Share App

To share your app with other users on your account during testing, go to the **Authorization URL** field, and select **Generate** and then **Copy**.
